subject: general
question: The Barabar caves, one of the oldest examples of Buddhist rock-cut architecture, are located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Barabar caves** are the oldest surviving rock-cut caves in India, located in the** Makhdumpur region of Jehanabad district, Bihar.**
 
• Emperor Ashoka built the Barabar Caves and these caves are Buddhist caves.
 
• The caves are situated in the twin hills of the Barabar and Nagarjuna hi
